title: Life Time Makes it Easier for Members to Find Competitive Matches with DUPR In-App Integration

body_markdown:
*Finding a competitive pickleball game just got easier as Life Time and DUPR expand strategic alliance to help members track progress, find better competition and improve their game*


**Key Highlights:**


- Life Time now integrates members' Dynamic Universal Pickleball Rating (DUPR) into the Life Time app, so players can find and match with others at a similar skill level straight from their phone.
- The rollout is complete at all Life Time clubs offering pickleball.
- The integration builds on the strategic alliance Life Time formed with DUPR in 2022, delivering a member-facing product.
- Life Time is one of the largest providers of pickleball in North America, with more than 960 permanent pickleball courts.


CHANHASSEN, Minn.


, Oct. 21, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / --[Life Time](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4802473-1&h=414118080&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lifetime.life%2F&a=Life+Time) (NYSE: LTH), the nation's premier healthy lifestyle brand and one of North America's largest providers of pickleball, is expanding its strategic alliance with[Dynamic Universal Pickleball Rating (DUPR)](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4802473-1&h=2122468880&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.dupr.com%2F&a=Dynamic+Universal+Pickleball+Rating+(DUPR)) , the world's most widely adopted pickleball rating system, to deliver an enhanced playing experience for members. Through the Life Time app, members are now able to connect their pickleball DUPR ratings, making it easier to measure progress and find the best competition at their club. Life Time also introduced nationwide DUPR-based programming, including rating-gated leagues, open play and other competitive opportunities to connect players of similar skill levels. The rollout began this summer at select clubs and is now complete across Life Time's network of pickleball courts nationwide.


DUPR is a rating system from 2.000 to 8.000 that groups players by ability using match results, coach input, and video and artificial intelligence analysis, so games stay balanced and competitive.


Members can link their Life Time member ID to their DUPR account directly in the app, then see their rating alongside the tools they already use to book courts, removing the guesswork from setting up an even game. Clubs can offer DUPR-gated Open Play for members with linked accounts, as well as leveled and all-level Open Play for members without a rating, and Life Time Pickleball Pros remain the primary resource for DUPR questions and guidance. Players can track their progress over time as their rating updates.


DUPR serves as the official rating system of Major League Pickleball (MLP), the Professional Pickleball Association (PPA) and is used by millions of players worldwide.


"As pickleball continues to grow at Life Time, many of our members are seeking out opponents at their skill level for more competitive matches and to grow their game," said Ryan Brister, Vice President of Racquet Sports at Life Time. "Bringing DUPR into our app does exactly that. It takes the friction out of matchmaking and helps our pickleball communities grow stronger."


"Life Time has been an incredible partner in growing pickleball, and this integration brings the value of a trusted rating directly into the member experience," said Tito Machado, CEO of DUPR. "The best pickleball experiences start with finding the right people to play with. Integrating DUPR into the Life Time app removes friction for players and gives members access to the same trusted rating system used across all levels of the sport."

**About Life Time** Life Time (NYSE: LTH) empowers people to live healthy, happy lives through its more than 195 athletic country clubs across the U.S. and Canada, the complimentary and comprehensive Life Time app featuring its L•AI•C™ AI-powered health companion, and more than 30 iconic athletic events. Serving people ages 90 days to 90+ years, the Life Time ecosystem uniquely delivers healthy living, healthy aging, and healthy entertainment experiences, a range of unique healthy way of life programs, highly trusted LTH nutritional supplements and more. Recognized as a Great Place to Work®, the company is committed to upholding an exceptional culture for its nearly 50,000 team members.


**About DUPR**
DUPR (Dynamic Universal Pickleball Rating) is the premier global pickleball rating system and technology platform, trusted by the world's leading clubs, tournaments, leagues, and players. DUPR's dynamic rating system unifies pickleball across age, gender, and location by analyzing match results to accurately evaluate all players across a 2.000 - 8.000 scale. DUPR is the official pickleball rating of leagues, tournaments and clubs around the world, including Global Pickleball Federation (GPF), USA Pickleball (USAP), United Pickleball Association (UPA), Professional Pickleball Association (PPA), Major League Pickleball (MLP), Pickleball.com, Life Time, The Picklr, National Team Pickleball League, National Pickleball League. It also owns and operates Minor League Pickleball and Collegiate Pickleball, two of the biggest amateur leagues in the sport. Players and operators can visit[www.dupr.com](http://www.dupr.com/) to sign up and learn more.
